newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sin Soon Huat active with 44 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Sin Soon Huat active with 44 mln shares.

text.p: Shares in industrial hardware maker Sin Soon Huat Ltd topped the actives early on Monday afternoon with more than 44 million shares traded, dealers said.
They said that included 21.689 million shares crossed at Singapore $0.73 and 21.48 million at S$0.735.
At 0210 GMT, the shares were up one cent at S$0.76.
"There is no corporate news surrounding the company that we are aware of," said a dealer with a local firm.
"It could based on their expectations of good results for full year ended May 31, 1997."
The company reported profits grew 30 percent to S$6.2 million for half year ended November 30, 1996.
